name: Alcuéscar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red with a chequy triangle of blue and white at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcuéscar (a castle on red beneath chequy).
history: The arms and the flag of Alcuéscar were approved by the Order of 2 September 1997 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 23 September 1997, after the municipal council had approved the arms on 29 July 1996; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, with a chequy blue and white triangle at the hoist.

features.role: chequy triangle of blue and white with its base along the hoist
